About This Plot

Plot No. 74, Phase 4, Century Eden

This is an East Facing and Park-Facing plot, 30 feet x 42 feet (1268 square feet), Located in Phase 4 of Century Eden on Doddaballapur Road. The East side has a 30 feet road. The West side has a 10 feet pathway with an open park directly behind it, so the plot has no immediate rear neighbour.

Century Eden is a gated plotted development by Century Real Estate spread across 52 acres on the Yelahanka–Doddaballapur Road in North Bengaluru, developed across five phases with plot sizes ranging roughly from 1200 square to 2400 square feet. Phase 4 carries its own RERA registration (PRM/KA/RERA/1250/301/PR/060623/005973).

The Plot is situated next to Provident Wellworth and close to the Doddaballapur Industrial Area. Expected price is ₹1.4 Cr.
